questions.q: Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to: ANCIENT
questions.x: 'Ancient' is the opposite of 'Modern'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Ancient'.

questions.q: Select the antonym of the word 'Optimist'.
questions.x: 'Optimist' is the opposite of 'Pessimist'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Optimist'.

questions.q: What does the phrase 'To cost an arm and a leg' mean?
questions.x: 'To cost an arm and a leg' means: to be very expensive.

questions.q: Choose the one word that can be substituted for: 'A word that is opposite in meaning'
questions.x: 'Antonym' means a word that is opposite in meaning.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
The cattle / is grazing / in the field.
questions.x: The error is in part (b): 'is grazing'. 'Cattle' is plural: 'are grazing'.

questions.q: Choose the one word that can be substituted for: 'A person who looks at the bright side of things'
questions.x: 'Optimist' means a person who looks at the bright side of things.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
I have / seen him / yesterday.
questions.x: The error is in part (b): 'seen him'. With 'yesterday', use simple past: 'I saw him yesterday'.

questions.q: Choose the option that best expresses the meaning of the idiom: 'To break the ice'
o: To start a conversation in an awkward situation
questions.x: 'To break the ice' means: to start a conversation in an awkward situation.

questions.q: Select the synonym of the word 'Scrutinise'.
questions.x: 'Scrutinise' means examine. 'Ignore' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
The new officer is / more smarter / than his predecessor.
questions.x: The error is in part (b): 'more smarter'. Double comparative: use 'smarter'.

questions.q: According to the passage, financial literacy mainly helps families to:
o: Avoid ruinous debt and fraudulent schemes
questions.x: Answer: 'Avoid ruinous debt and fraudulent schemes'. The last sentence states this benefit. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Savings habits are formed early. Children who see their parents keep a small amount aside each week tend to treat saving as normal rather than as sacrifice. Schools can reinforce this by teaching simple ideas such as compound interest and the difference between needs and wants. Financial literacy does not make everyone rich, but it protects families from ruinous debt and from schemes that promise impossible returns.

questions.q: Which concept is mentioned as suitable to be taught in schools?
questions.x: Answer: 'Compound interest'. The passage mentions compound interest and needs versus wants. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Savings habits are formed early. Children who see their parents keep a small amount aside each week tend to treat saving as normal rather than as sacrifice. Schools can reinforce this by teaching simple ideas such as compound interest and the difference between needs and wants. Financial literacy does not make everyone rich, but it protects families from ruinous debt and from schemes that promise impossible returns.

questions.q: The Vernacular Press Act, 1878, often called the 'gagging Act', was passed by:
questions.x: Amrita Bazar Patrika converted overnight into an English newspaper to escape it.

questions.q: The Muslim League observed 'Direct Action Day' on:
questions.x: Correct answer: 16 August 1946. Large-scale riots broke out in Calcutta.

questions.q: Subhas Chandra Bose is associated with the founding of:
questions.x: Subhas Chandra Bose founded the Forward Bloc (1939).

questions.q:
In which year did the following take place?
The Gandhi–Irwin Pact was signed.
questions.x: The Gandhi–Irwin Pact was signed in 1931. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q: 'Saare Jahan Se Achha' was written by:
questions.x: Correct answer: Muhammad Iqbal. It was written in 1904.

questions.q: The Simon Commission was boycotted because:
o: It was headed by a Viceroy
questions.x: Lala Lajpat Rai was fatally injured in a lathi charge during protests in Lahore.

questions.q: Who designed the national flag adopted by the Constituent Assembly, based on a flag he had earlier designed?
questions.x: The Assembly adopted the tricolour with the Ashoka Chakra on 22 July 1947.

questions.q: The Chauri Chaura incident led Gandhi to withdraw Non-Cooperation — this happened in the year:
questions.x: The Chauri Chaura incident led Gandhi to withdraw Non-Cooperation in 1922. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q: The Revolt of 1857 began at Meerut on:
questions.x: Mangal Pandey's act at Barrackpore (29 March 1857) preceded it; sepoys at Meerut revolted on 10 May and marched to Delhi.

questions.q: Who presided over the 1922 session of the Indian National Congress held at Gaya?
questions.x: C. R. Das presided over the 1922 Gaya session — the session after which the Swaraj Party was formed.

questions.q: Which day is observed on 14 November?
questions.x: 14 November is Children's Day (Jawaharlal Nehru).

questions.q: COP29 (2024), held in Baku, adopted a 'New Collective Quantified Goal' on climate finance of at least:
o: US$ 300 billion per year by 2035 for developing countries
US$ 1 trillion per year by 2030 from public funds
questions.x: It also called for scaling up total finance to US$ 1.3 trillion a year from all sources.

questions.q: 'PM-PRANAM' scheme encourages States to:
o: Reduce the use of chemical fertilisers
questions.x: Correct answer: Reduce the use of chemical fertilisers. States get a share of the subsidy saved.

questions.q: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, who began a second term in 2025, is the Director-General of the:
questions.x: Correct answer: World Trade Organization. She is the first woman and first African to head the WTO.

questions.q: The 'Mera Yuva Bharat' (MY Bharat) platform, launched in 2023, is meant for:
o: Engaging youth in volunteering and development activities
questions.x: Correct answer: Engaging youth in volunteering and development activities. It was launched on National Unity Day (31 October).

questions.q: The 'PM SHRI' scheme aims to:
o: Upgrade selected schools as model schools showcasing NEP 2020
questions.x: Correct answer: Upgrade selected schools as model schools showcasing NEP 2020. It covers over 14,500 schools.

questions.q: How many medals did India win at the Paris Olympics 2024?
o: Seven (one gold, two silver, four bronze)
questions.x: Correct answer: Six (one silver, five bronze). Neeraj Chopra won silver; Manu Bhaker won two bronzes.

questions.q: The 'World Press Freedom Index' is published by:
questions.x: 'World Press Freedom Index' is brought out by Reporters Without Borders.

questions.q: The 2025 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to:
questions.x: Correct answer: María Corina Machado. She was recognised for promoting democratic rights in Venezuela.

questions.q: 'Gender budgeting' means:
o: Separate budgets for men and women
Analysing and allocating public expenditure with attention to its impact on women and girls
questions.x: India's Union Budget has carried a Gender Budget Statement since 2005–06.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Power of the President to promulgate Ordinances during recess of Parliament"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 123.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Remedies for enforcement of Fundamental Rights (writs by the Supreme Court)"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 32.

questions.q: The Constituent Assembly of India held its first meeting on:
questions.x: Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha was the provisional chairman; Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected President on 11 December 1946.

questions.q: The Constitution (36th Amendment) Act, 1975:
o: Reduced the voting age from 21 to 18 years
Introduced the Goods and Services Tax
Made Sikkim a full-fledged State of the Indian Union
Affirmed Parliament's power to amend any part of the Constitution, including Fundamental Rights
questions.x: The 36th Amendment (1975) made Sikkim a full-fledged State of the Indian Union.

questions.q: The Finance Commission is constituted by the President every:
questions.x: Article 280; it recommends distribution of tax revenues between the Centre and States.

questions.q: Article 110 of the Constitution of India deals with:
o: Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the House of the People
Laws inconsistent with or in derogation of Fundamental Rights
questions.x: Article 110: Definition of 'Money Bills'.

questions.q: The maximum number of ministers in the Union Council of Ministers, including the PM, cannot exceed what percentage of the total members of the Lok Sabha?
questions.x: Correct answer: 15%. The 91st Amendment (2003) set this limit.

questions.q: Which committee recommended the inclusion of Fundamental Duties in the Constitution?
questions.x: Correct answer: Swaran Singh Committee (1976). Its recommendations were implemented through the 42nd Amendment.

questions.q: Article 324 of the Constitution of India deals with:
o: Protection of life and personal liberty
Superintendence, direction and control of elections vested in an Election Commission
Composition of the House of the People (Lok Sabha)
questions.x: Article 324: Superintendence, direction and control of elections vested in an Election Commission.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Rajya Sabha can initiate a Money Bill.
2. The Rajya Sabha has exclusive powers under Article 249 and Article 312.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.x:
Statement 1 is incorrect; Statement 2 is correct.
Money Bills can be introduced only in the Lok Sabha. The Rajya Sabha has special powers to authorise Parliament to legislate on State subjects and create All-India Services.

questions.q: In an economy, GDP at market prices is ₹3,57,000 crore, net factor income from abroad is ₹-4,300 crore and depreciation is ₹27,000 crore. NNP at market prices is:
A market with a single seller and many buyers is called:
questions.x: Correct answer: Monopoly. Monopsony has a single buyer.

questions.q:
In which year did the following happen?
The Reserve Bank of India began operations.
questions.x: The Reserve Bank of India began operations in 1935.

questions.q: A 'scheduled bank' is one that is:
o: Included in the Second Schedule of the RBI Act, 1934
questions.x: Correct answer: Included in the Second Schedule of the RBI Act, 1934. Scheduled banks can borrow from the RBI and must maintain CRR.

questions.q: The 'fiscal policy' of a government deals with:
questions.x: Correct answer: Taxation and public expenditure. Monetary policy is the RBI's domain.

questions.q: The 'expenditure method' of measuring GDP sums:
o: Consumption + Investment + Government expenditure + Net exports
questions.x: Correct answer: Consumption + Investment + Government expenditure + Net exports. GDP = C + I + G + (X − M).

questions.q: "Human resource development, in the context of economic reforms (Rao–Manmohan model)" was the focus of which plan?
questions.x: It was the Eighth Five-Year Plan (1992–97).

questions.q: PM-KISAN provides eligible farmer families an income support of:
questions.x: Correct answer: ₹6,000 per year in three instalments. Launched in February 2019, the transfer is made through DBT.

questions.q: The 'Swachh Bharat Mission' was launched on:
questions.x: Correct answer: 2 October 2014. It aimed at an open-defecation-free India by 2019.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a dimension of the Human Development Index?
questions.x: Correct answer: Gender parity in parliament. Gender is captured in separate indices like GII and GDI.

questions.q: Interest on debentures is:
o: A charge against profit, payable whether or not there is profit
questions.x: Correct answer: A charge against profit, payable whether or not there is profit. Dividend is an appropriation; debenture interest is an expense.

questions.q: P and Q share profits in the ratio 5 : 1. They admit R for a 1/5 share, which R acquires from P and Q in their existing ratio. The new profit-sharing ratio of P, Q and R is:
Under AS 2 / Ind AS 2, inventories are valued at:
o: Lower of cost and net realisable value
questions.x: Correct answer: Lower of cost and net realisable value. This applies the prudence principle.

questions.q: The current ratio of a company is 2 : 1 and its working capital is ₹30,000. Its current assets amount to:
questions.x:
Let current liabilities = x. Then current assets = 2x and working capital = 2x − x = 1x.
1x = 30,000 → x = ₹30,000.
Current assets = 2 × 30,000 = ₹60,000.

questions.q: The profits of a firm for the last 3 years were ₹87,000, ₹27,000, ₹81,000. Goodwill is to be valued at 2.5 years' purchase of the average profit. Goodwill is:
The cash book of a firm shows a debit (bank) balance of ₹10,000. Cheques issued but not yet presented: ₹4,500; cheques deposited but not yet credited: ₹5,000. The balance as per the pass book is:
questions.x:
Start with cash book balance ₹10,000.
+ Cheques issued not presented (bank has not yet paid) 4,500
− Cheques deposited not credited 5,000
Pass book balance = ₹9,500.

questions.q: On retirement of a partner, the remaining partners compensate the retiring partner for goodwill in the:
questions.x: Gaining ratio = new ratio − old ratio of continuing partners.

questions.q: Purchases during a month: 1st — 100 units @ ₹12; 10th — 150 units @ ₹13; 20th — 250 units @ ₹16. 350 units were issued on the 25th. Value of closing stock under FIFO is:
questions.x: Under FIFO the earliest units are issued first, so the 150 units left come from the latest purchases: 150 × ₹16 = ₹2,400.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
Assertion (A): Outstanding salary is shown as a current liability.
Reason (R): Under the accrual concept, expenses incurred but unpaid at year-end must be recognised.
Select the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.x: A is true and R is true; R correctly explains A. Accrual explains why outstanding salary appears as a liability.

questions.q: Machinery costing ₹1,80,000 is depreciated at 20% per annum on the Written Down Value method. Its book value at the end of 2 years will be:
questions.x:
WDV: depreciation each year is charged on the opening book value.
Book value = Cost × (1 − r)ⁿ = 1,80,000 × (0.8)^2 = ₹1,15,200.
(SLM at the same rate would give ₹1,08,000.)

questions.q: Goods sold on credit to Mohan are recorded as:
o: Mohan A/c Dr. To Sales A/c
Mohan A/c Dr. To Purchases A/c
Cash A/c Dr. To Sales A/c
Sales A/c Dr. To Mohan A/c
questions.x: Correct answer: Mohan A/c Dr. To Sales A/c. Mohan is the receiver (debtor) and sales revenue is credited.

questions.q: Fixed costs are ₹1,57,500, selling price is ₹85 per unit and variable cost is ₹60 per unit. The break-even point in units is:
questions.x:
Contribution per unit = 85 − 60 = ₹25.
BEP (units) = Fixed cost / Contribution per unit = 1,57,500 / 25 = 6,300 units.

questions.q: Which of the following assets is generally NOT depreciated?
questions.x: Correct answer: Freehold land. Land has an indefinite useful life.

questions.q: Interest received on investments is a:
questions.x: Correct answer: Revenue receipt. Recurring income from normal operations or investments is revenue.

questions.q: The headquarters of the International Labour Organization is located in:
questions.x: The ILO and its secretariat, the International Labour Office, are based in Geneva, Switzerland.

questions.q: Which Act was the first to introduce a statutory framework for compensation for occupational injuries in India?
questions.x: The 1923 Act, based on employer liability, required compensation for employment injuries.

questions.q: The OSH Code makes it the duty of every employer to ensure that the workplace is free from:
o: Hazards which cause or are likely to cause injury or occupational disease
questions.x: Section 6 places a general duty on employers to keep workplaces free from hazards causing injury or occupational disease.

questions.q: A shop has 8 employees, all men. Under the POSH Act, complaints of sexual harassment from a woman visitor to this shop would be handled by:
o: The Local Committee constituted by the District Officer
questions.x: Workplaces with fewer than 10 employees have no Internal Committee; the district Local Committee receives such complaints.

questions.q: The Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) is conducted by:
questions.x: PLFS, launched in 2017, is conducted by the NSO under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.

questions.q: In which case did the Supreme Court hold that payment of less than the minimum wage amounts to 'forced labour' under Article 23?
o: Bandhua Mukti Morcha v. Union of India (1984)
Minerva Mills v. Union of India (1980)
Randhir Singh v. Union of India (1982)
People's Union for Democratic Rights v. Union of India (Asiad Workers' case, 1982)
questions.x: In the Asiad Workers' case the Court held that labour for less than minimum wage, compelled by economic necessity, is forced labour.

questions.q: The Code on Wages, 2019 subsumes all of the following EXCEPT:
questions.x: The Code on Wages subsumes Payment of Wages, Minimum Wages, Payment of Bonus and Equal Remuneration. Gratuity is in the Code on Social Security.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about inter-State migrant workers under the OSH Code:
1. Workers who migrate on their own, not only through a contractor, are covered.
2. A workers' database and toll-free helpline are envisaged.
3. Migrant workers lose access to the Public Distribution System outside their home State.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.x:
Statement 1 is correct; Statement 2 is correct; Statement 3 is incorrect.
The OSH Code widens the definition to self-migrating workers and envisages a database and helpline; portability of benefits (including PDS) is intended, not denial.

questions.q: Which Code introduced the concept of a 'national floor wage'?
questions.x: Section 9 of the Code on Wages empowers the Central Government to fix a floor wage below which no State may set its minimum wage.

questions.q: The ILO was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in which year?
questions.x: The ILO received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1969, its 50th anniversary year.

questions.q: Identify the year of enactment of the Employees' State Insurance Act.
questions.x: The Employees' State Insurance Act was enacted in 1948.

questions.q: 'Dearness Allowance' paid to employees is primarily meant to:
o: Neutralise the effect of rising prices on wages
questions.x: DA is linked to a consumer price index (e.g., CPI-IW) and revised periodically.

questions.q:
Match the constitutional provision with its labour-related content:
Article:
A. Article 23
B. Article 24
C. Article 43A
D. Article 39(d)
Content:
1. No child below 14 in factories, mines or hazardous work
2. Prohibition of forced labour
3. Equal pay for equal work for men and women
4. Participation of workers in management
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.x:
Correct matching — A (Article 23) → 2 (Prohibition of forced labour); B (Article 24) → 1 (No child below 14 in factories, mines or hazardous work); C (Article 43A) → 4 (Participation of workers in management); D (Article 39(d)) → 3 (Equal pay for equal work for men and women).
These are the core labour-related provisions in Part III (23, 24) and Part IV (39(d), 43A).

questions.q: Child labour in India is constitutionally prohibited in factories and mines for children below:
questions.x: Article 24 prohibits employment of children below 14 in factories, mines and hazardous employment.

questions.q: In the context of industrial relations, 'check-off' refers to:
o: Approval of a strike by secret ballot
Deduction of union subscription from wages by the employer for remittance to the union
questions.x: Correct answer: Deduction of union subscription from wages by the employer for remittance to the union. Check-off is often used to verify union membership for recognition.

questions.q: Under the IR Code, an Industrial Tribunal consists of:
o: Three members nominated by trade unions
Only a retired High Court judge
A Judicial Member and an Administrative Member
questions.x: The IR Code reconstitutes Tribunals with two members — a Judicial Member and an Administrative Member — replacing Labour Courts.

questions.q: The Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance (EDLI) Scheme came into force in:
questions.x: EDLI was introduced on 1 August 1976.

questions.q: Under EPS 1995, the minimum pensionable service required to earn a monthly pension is:
questions.x: With less than 10 years, the member gets a withdrawal benefit instead of a monthly pension.

questions.q: A worker covered by ESI earns ₹20,000 a month. The employee's ESI contribution for the month is:
Atal Pension Yojana (APY) was launched in:
questions.x: APY was launched on 9 May 2015, replacing the Swavalamban scheme.

questions.q: Which document generated by EPFO shows a member's monthly contributions and interest credits?
questions.x: Correct answer: EPF passbook. Members can view the passbook online via the member portal or UMANG.

questions.q: Paternity leave for male Central Government employees under the CCS (Leave) Rules is:
questions.x: Male central government employees with fewer than two surviving children get 15 days' paternity leave.

questions.q: Which of the following is the self-registration portal for unorganised workers under the Ministry of Labour and Employment?
questions.x: e-Shram (2021) is the national database; Udyam is for MSMEs, GeM for procurement.

questions.q: In a 'defined contribution' scheme such as NPS:
o: Benefits depend on contributions and investment returns; the member bears the investment risk
Benefits are guaranteed by the employer
questions.x: Correct answer: Benefits depend on contributions and investment returns; the member bears the investment risk. DC schemes shift investment and longevity risk to members.

questions.q: An employee's monthly basic wages plus DA are ₹13,000. Of the employer's 12% contribution, how much is credited to the Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS) account?
questions.x:
Employer's 12% = ₹1,560. Of this, 8.33% of wages (on a wage ceiling of ₹15,000) goes to EPS: 8.33% × 13,000 = ₹1,083.
The balance ₹477 (3.67%) goes to the EPF account. The employee's own 12% (₹1,560) goes entirely to EPF.

questions.q: The EPF provision allowing a member to take an advance for purchase/construction of a house generally requires minimum membership of:
questions.x: Earlier, housing advances under Para 68B required five years of membership; the 2025 changes reduced minimum service for all withdrawals to 12 months.

questions.q: Under Section 12 of the EPF & MP Act, an employer is prohibited from:
o: Reducing an employee's wages because of the employer's liability to contribute
questions.x: The employer cannot deduct its own share from the employee's wages or reduce wages to offset contributions.

questions.q: Under the Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995, a member retires at 58 with pensionable salary of ₹15,000 and pensionable service of 34 years (including any weightage). The monthly member pension is:
questions.x:
Monthly pension = (Pensionable salary × Pensionable service) / 70
= (15,000 × 34) / 70 = ₹7,286.
Pensionable salary is the average of the last 60 months' wages (subject to the ₹15,000 ceiling), and the minimum pension is ₹1,000.

questions.q: Theory of relativity is credited to:
questions.x: Theory of relativity: Albert Einstein.

questions.q: The causative agent of AIDS is:
o: Dengue virus (a flavivirus spread by Aedes mosquitoes)
questions.x: AIDS: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV).

questions.q: 'Captcha' tests are used on websites to:
o: Distinguish human users from automated bots
questions.x: Correct answer: Distinguish human users from automated bots. They prevent automated abuse.

questions.q: Deficiency of Vitamin B3 (niacin) causes:
questions.x: Vitamin B3 (niacin) deficiency → Pellagra.

questions.q: The 'Golden rice' is genetically modified to be rich in:
questions.x: Correct answer: Vitamin A precursor (beta-carotene). It addresses vitamin A deficiency.

questions.q: The 'Ampere' is the SI unit of:
questions.x: Ampere measures electric current.

questions.q: The chemical name/formula of 'common salt' is:
questions.x: Common salt = NaCl (sodium chloride).

questions.q: Which nutrient is the main source of energy for the body?
questions.x: Correct answer: Carbohydrates. Fats give more energy per gram (about 9 kcal vs 4 kcal).

questions.q: 'Defragmentation' of a hard disk:
o: Rearranges fragmented files to improve access speed
questions.x: Correct answer: Rearranges fragmented files to improve access speed. It is unnecessary for SSDs.

questions.q: A seismograph is used to measure:
questions.x: Seismograph: Earthquake waves.

questions.q: Which abbreviation stands for 'Random Access Memory'?
questions.x: Random Access Memory is abbreviated as RAM.

questions.q: Bacteria and fungi that break down dead organisms are called:
questions.x: Correct answer: Decomposers. They recycle nutrients in the ecosystem.

questions.q: What is the remainder when 448 × 167 × 379 is divided by 9?
questions.x:
Use remainders: 448 mod 9 = 7, 167 mod 9 = 5, 379 mod 9 = 1.
7 × 5 × 1 = 35 → mod 9 = 8.

questions.q: Two inlet pipes can fill a reservoir in 5 hours and 12 hours respectively, while an outlet pipe can empty the full tank in 30 hours. If all three are opened together on an empty tank, it will be full in:
questions.x:
Take tank capacity = LCM(5, 12, 30) = 60 units.
Rates: +12, +5, −2 units/hour → net 15 units/hour.
Time = 60 / 15 = 4 hours.

questions.q: Asha and Bhavna together can verify a batch of claims in 20 days. Asha alone can do it in 30 days. How many days will Bhavna alone take?
questions.x:
Bhavna's one-day work = 1/20 − 1/30 = (30 − 20)/600 = 1/60.
So Bhavna alone takes 60 days.

questions.q: A bus runs from town P to town Q at 30 km/h and returns along the same road at 42 km/h. The average speed for the whole journey is:
questions.x:
For equal distances, average speed = 2uv/(u + v) (harmonic mean), not (u + v)/2.
= 2 × 30 × 42 / (30 + 42) = 2520/72 = 35 km/h.

questions.q: What is the unit digit of 23^110?
questions.x:
Unit digit depends only on 3. Powers of 3 repeat with cycle 4: 3, 9, 7, 1.
110 ÷ 4 leaves remainder 2 → use position 2 of the cycle → 9.

questions.q: The weekly overtime hours are: 45, 89, 85, 37, 19, 22, 55. Their arithmetic mean is:
questions.x: Sum = 352; number of values = 7. Mean = 352/7 = 50.29.

questions.q: The ratio of the present ages of P and Q is 5 : 3. After 15 years, the ratio will become 15 : 11. What is P's present age?

Claims settled (in thousand) over five years — 2021: 235  |  2022: 225  |  2023: 260  |  2024: 300  |  2025: 320.
What is the average per year over the five years?
Find the odd one out among 143, 102, 117 and 104.
questions.x: 104, 143, 117 are all multiples of 13; 102 is not. Hence 102 is the odd one out.

questions.q: What is the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 8:15?
questions.x:
Angle = |30H − 5.5M| = |30×8 − 5.5×15| = |240 − 82.5| = 157.5°.
Smaller angle = 157.5°.
(The minute hand gains 5.5° per minute over the hour hand.)

questions.q: A trader buys a steel almirah for ₹1,250 and sells it for ₹1,400. His profit per cent is:
questions.x:
Profit = SP − CP = ₹1,400 − ₹1,250 = ₹150.
Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100 = (150 / 1,250) × 100 = 12%.
(Profit % is always on cost price, not on selling price.)

questions.q: There are 42 names in a queue at a counter. Rahul's name is 24th from the top. What is its position from the bottom?
questions.x: Position from bottom = Total − position from top + 1 = 42 − 24 + 1 = 19.

questions.q: A rectangular plot measures 23 m by 21 m. What is the cost of fencing it at ₹18 per metre?
The average weight of 24 parcels is 70 kg. When one more parcel is added, the average becomes 73 kg. The weight of the new parcel is:
questions.x:
Old total = 24 × 70 = 1680 kg. New total = 25 × 73 = 1825 kg.
New parcel = 1825 − 1680 = 145 kg.
Shortcut: new value = new average + (increase × old count) = 73 + 3 × 24 = 145 kg.
